epics.title: Epic: Multi-Stream Kernel Release Matrix & Upstream Synchronization
epics.description: Establish automated kernel compilation, patching, and verification across 4 live release streams (bleeding 7.3-rc2, mainstream 7.2.4, lts 6.18.50, realtime 7.2-rt).

epics.title: Epic: Hardened KConfig Baselines & KSPP CIS L2 Compliance
epics.description: Construct composable, security-hardened kernel configuration fragments meeting Kernel Self-Protection Project (KSPP) and CIS Linux Benchmark Level 2 baselines.

epics.title: Epic: Multi-Architecture Cross-Compilation Engine (x86_64, arm64, riscv64)
epics.description: Build hermetic, cross-compilation pipeline leveraging LLVM/Clang and GCC toolchains across x86_64, ARM64, and RISC-V 64 targets.

epics.title: Epic: Dual Packaging Pipeline (.deb & systemd-ukify UKI EFI)
epics.description: Standardize dual packaging producing native Debian `.deb` archives and Unified Kernel Image (UKI) `.efi` executables measured into TPM 2.0 PCR 11.

epics.title: Epic: Enterprise CI/CD, Supply Chain Attestation & Downstream Dispatch
epics.description: Deploy an enterprise 12-workflow GitHub Actions CI/CD matrix with OpenSSF Scorecard, Semgrep SAST, Trivy CVE scanning, and branch protection aggregator.

epics.title: Epic: Next-Gen Hardware Acceleration & Scheduler Engine (Blackwell, Xe2, BBRv3, sched-ext)
epics.description: Curate high-performance patches and drivers for NVIDIA Blackwell B200 / RTX 5090, Intel Xe2 Battlemage, AMD ROCm 10, BBRv3, and eBPF sched-ext.
